item.title: Timor-Leste Rejects Climate Hysteria, Embraces Development
item.description: The true threat to the people of Timor-Leste is not a slightly warmer world or a few millimeters of sea-level rise; it is economic decline from a lack of affordable, reliable energy like that derived from coal, oil, and natural gas.

item.title: America’s Energy Independence Threatened By “Dark Money” Lawfare
item.description: Beyond distorting our law and politics, this climate lawfare inflicts another harm on America: it suppresses production of reliable energy sources like natural gas in favor of weather-dependent windmills and solar panels.

item.title: Panic-Stricken Climate Alarmists Resort to Bolder Lies
item.description: The real misinformation has been repeated predictions of apocalypse, fabricated links between bad weather and a harmless gas necessary for life on Earth and attacks on the reputations of those who question climate orthodoxy.

item.title: Green California to Keep Diablo Canyon Nuclear Plant Open 5 More Years
item.description: Some Californians question why they need a nuclear plant, given all their renewable and battery investments.

item.title: Today’s IQ Test: Which Is Cheaper To Produce Electricity, Wind/Solar Or Fossil Fuels?
item.description: So who is right? We’ve had a long wait here in the U.S. as groups of states have incrementally differentiated their energy systems, and then as data have accumulated as to relative costs between states that have emphasized the “renewables” and those that have stuck with fossil fuels. At this point I think that we can make a definitive call. The answer is that increasing penetration of wind and solar generation on the grid drives electricity costs higher. And not by a little.

item.title: One state’s green mandates can become another state’s nightmare
item.description: States that have adopted “clean-energy” mandates are accustomed to having ratepayers in other states help them pick up the tab for their headlong march to a green utopia. This is especially true when this involves stringing high-voltage transmission lines across vast expanses to conduct intermittent wind and solar power generated in remote locations.

item.title: Miliband Isolated as EU Prepares to Reverse Petrol Car Ban
item.description: Ed Miliband has been left isolated over his Net Zero policies after the European Union dropped “indefinitely” a flagship pledge to ban sales of new petrol cars.
